name: S. M. Wills
bio: S. M. Wills of Mingusville bought saddle horses from John Goodall in June 1885. In April 1886 his gray horse won a 300-yard race against Pierre Wibaux's dun after Wibaux's rider fell off.

moments.label: His gray beat Pierre Wibaux's dun in a race
